thesis: Navan (NAVN) trades about 11% below its Aug 27 close but still ~41% above its 200-day average and ~12% under its 52-week high. The move follows the Sept 9 fiscal Q2 2027 report: revenue ~$232.8M (+35% YoY), gross booking value >$3B (+45%), full-year revenue guidance raised to $927-933M and non-GAAP operating income guidance to $82-86M. The stock nonetheless fell ~17% on the print on reported margin pressure, so the market is weighing strong growth against margins; this suggests the fundamental read is positive but not resolved. The Sept 9 catalyst is older than 15 trading days and no counter-case is explicitly resolved on company fundamentals, so conviction stays medium. A 2025 IPO-related securities class action (McCown v. Navan, N.D. Cal., filed Feb 2026; lead-plaintiff deadline Apr 24, 2026 already passed) and plaintiff-firm investigations exist, but no scheduled ruling/hearing within ~90 days was found, so not flagged.
invalidation: Guidance cut or a further margin decline in the next report, a close below the 200-day average, or a scheduled adverse ruling/new governance event in the IPO litigation.
sources: Navan Q2 FY2027 press release (Business Wire): https://secure.businesswire.com/news/home/20260907276239/en/Navan-Announces-Strong-Second-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2027-Results
